description: Content pipeline created duplicate Ghost draft posts for digest-sourced content (The Amplifier Paradox, DFW Is Building the Other Kind of AI Economy, The Rollout Worked. The People Didn't.). The 48h fallback in read.py — triggered when the 24h window returns 0 messages — pulled Watchtower digest bot messages from the prior day back into scope. Dedup logic checked source_url only; digest entries have source_url: null, so no URL match was possible. The title was not checked against pending-drafts.json, so the same digest was drafted and posted to Ghost a second time.
correction: Dedup must also compare the extracted H1 title from a digest message against all existing title fields in pending-drafts.json (case-insensitive). A title match on any status entry should skip the message with a logged note.
systemic_fix: Added digest title dedup rule to step-01-discover.md Section 3 (Check deduplication): for digest messages, extract H1 and compare case-insensitively against all pending-drafts.json title fields before drafting. Skip with note if match found.
